decisions.reason: Core airfield lighting control remains integral to the integrated airfield solution despite reduced website visibility.
Surveillance display supports tower and gate operations, though some functions may migrate to newer MLAT-based systems.
Airport systems training program is a recurring service offering aligned with the firm's consultative approach.
Airfield ground lighting training course complements the installed base and maintains specialist expertise.
Airport collaboration software tool supports the firm's move toward integrated, data-driven airport operations.
Flagship multilateration surveillance system is central to the firm's strategic direction and market differentiation.
